Coding agents can now run to attach and debug tests over — perfect for automatically fixing tests in agentic workflows:

$ npx playwright --debug=cli - Run to attach to this $ playwright-cli attach tw-87b59e Run commands with: playwright-cli --session=tw-87b59e command - Navigate to at output/tests/example.spec.ts:4 $ playwright-cli --session tw-87b59e step-o
